design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (member_cost_sharing_and_renewal, category plan)

1. Why this is a good test. A father asks only to pay what is needed to re-enroll his daughter Anouk Brevard-Oyelowo, whose CHIP Kids membership ended 2026-04-30 for premium non-payment (lockout of 90 days runs to 2026-07-29; review 2026-06-30). The scored payment (98.00, a user tool he runs himself) waits on two claims-side corrections the charter states and the records show unmet: the approved physical therapy course was rated visit by visit, and ambulance transports of a wheelchair-van-dependent child carry the full ambulance copay. Both corrections are copay reversals offset against the lockout balance, so they change the payment. Every write is a multi-factor computation over the premium and claim ledgers plus auth, ride and care records.

2. Scope. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[5,5,6]; realised: lockout balance payment 5, ambulance transport re-rating 5, therapy course re-rating 6. Occupied by task 0: plan_ext_over_cap_refund, plan_ext_past_due_premium_payment, plan_ext_own_pcp_visit_rerating, plan_ext_office_visit_preventive_rerating and tools b068d625, fdc43b6b, ea94b99c, 0e97c2c0. Claimed here: plan_ext_lockout_balance_payment (root, pay_lockout_premium_balance_44198c5a, owner user), plan_ext_therapy_course_rerating (book_therapy_course_rerating_7ffa3e71), plan_ext_ambulance_transport_rerating (book_ambulance_transport_rerating_8b982fa6). The seven policies are covered once each; in this world the task-0 state-due policies evaluate to 0.00 (over-cap refund: counted total far under a 5% cap on 5251.00 a month; no PCP assignment or visit log, so both PCP re-ratings are 0.00).

3. Problem-tree card (fan-out, both edges state form, value_input, gate credit_offset).
 - lockout payment <- therapy course re-rating. Sentence (negated direction, the way a premium desk states that it does not accept a balance until corrections stand): "The lockout balance is not accepted until the visits of the member's approved therapy course carry their course re-rating adjustment entry." Seed: C26-0105-40690 (latest course visit, NPI 1629384750) member_cost_share 15.0, no adjustment references it. Only the course re-rating books such an entry. Skipping it: payment 171.50 instead of 98.00.
 - lockout payment <- ambulance transport re-rating. Sentence (affirmative): "The lockout balance is fixed only after the ambulance claims under review carry their ambulance re-rating adjustment entry." Seed: C26-0424-43512 member_cost_share 10.0, no adjustment. Skipping it: payment 126.50.
 - Four-point test: ordering connective (not until / only after); record-visible state (an adjustment entry standing on the named claims); no tool, id or code token; scope = the batch each depended-on rule defines. Derivation: sentence + claim ledger + depended-on rule ('booked as one adjustment entry that names the most recently serviced claim ...') -> exactly one write each.
 - Order: course re-rating (step 11), ambulance re-rating (13), payment (15, user). Commute: replaying the ambulance re-rating first gives 73.50 / 28.50 / 98.00 and a byte-identical terminal DB.
 - user_scenario names neither prerequisite; the tools validate nothing.

4. Factor cards (handling time).
 therapy course re-rating = 73.50 (all-baseline 0.00).
  - course_scope_by_authorization_dates (method, cross-difficulty auth): start 2025-10-13 inside the window, end 2026-04-10 passed -> visits 2025-10..2026-04: 6 visits, 90.00; baseline all 7 visits of the provider in the window (incl. the 2025-09-29 evaluation) -> 88.50. Near-miss: the evaluation visit.
  - course_visit_copay_by_discipline (parameter, auth): physical therapy -> 2.00; baseline 15.00 -> 34.50.
  - course_intake_visits (parameter, auth): in-network course -> 1 intake visit kept at 15.00; baseline 0 -> 88.00.
  - extension_visit_copay (parameter, auth + care): 8 units approved above 4 requested AND a care episode enrolled in the window -> 2 extension visits at 0.00; baseline = regular copay -> 72.50.
  - therapy_transport_credit (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty ride): RideLink Wheelchair Van AND 4 completed trips to the therapy provider -> 1.00; baseline 0 -> 70.50.
  - therapy_care_plan_credit (parameter, care): care episode enrolled in the window AND care plan signed 2025-09-30 -> 0.50; baseline 0 -> 72.00.
  Re-rated = 1 x 15.00 + 2 x 0.00 + 3 x MX(0, 2.00 - 1.00 - 0.50) = 16.50; reversal 90.00 - 16.50 = 73.50.
 ambulance transport re-rating = 28.50 (all-baseline 0.00).
  - ambulance_review_reach (method, ride + auth): wheelchair van AND approved power wheelchair authorization PA-2509-120377 -> 12 months: 3 transports (2025-08-12, 2026-01-14, 2026-04-24), 30.00; baseline 3 months -> only 2026-04-24 -> 9.50.
  - ambulance_copay_by_level_of_service (parameter, ride): wheelchair van -> 5.00; baseline 10.00 -> 13.50.
  - discharge_transport_credit (parameter, multi-source ride + care): 2 hospital discharge trips (2025-08-14, 2026-01-16) AND a care episode enrolled in the twelve months -> 2.50; baseline 0 -> 21.00.
  - long_distance_transport_credit (parameter, ride): longest trip 58.4 miles >= 50 -> 1.00; baseline 0 -> 25.50.
  - care_tier_transport_credit (parameter, care): Care Coordination Level 2 episode enrolled 2025-09-03 -> 1.00; baseline 0 -> 25.50.
  Re-rated copay MX(0, 5.00 - 2.50 - 1.00 - 1.00) = 0.50; reversal 30.00 - 3 x 0.50 = 28.50.
 lockout balance payment = 98.00 (all-baseline 400.00).
  - void_bill_by_termination (method): the latest bill (2026-05) began after the 2026-04-30 termination AND was posted 2026-04-01, before it -> that bill alone void: 7 owed months (the other tier voids every bill posted on or after the termination date; the fall-through owes every unsettled month); baseline 8 -> 133.00. Near-miss: the 2026-05 bill.
  - lockout_month_rate_by_income_band (parameter): income 196% within the second band -> 35.00 (the bills kept the 50.00 band after the 2025-08-20 state-file income change); baseline the latest bill 50.00 -> 203.00.
  - credit_offset_on_lockout (method): copay reversals booked in the window AND no over-cap refund -> only the copay reversals offset (tiers read which credits were booked, never the termination reason) (73.50 + 28.50 = 102.00); baseline no offset -> 200.00.
  - medical_need_relief (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty auth): physical therapy authorization approved on a 2025-10-06 request, since expired, AND a care episode enrolled 2025-09-03 -> 35.00; baseline 0 -> 133.00.
  - first_default_relief (parameter): 8 payments posted 2025-01-16..2025-08-15 within the 18 months, no hardship waiver -> 10.00; baseline 0 -> 108.00. Near-miss: the 2024-12-27 payment is 18 whole months back and falls outside.
  Payment = 7 x 35.00 - 102.00 - 35.00 - 10.00 = 98.00.

5. Base-invariant card. Both re-ratings inherit plan_evt_claim_adjustment: original_is_paid (C26-0105-40690, C26-0424-43512 paid), adjust_window (booked 2026-01-14 / 2026-04-30; from the day after, 365 days inclusive; review 2026-06-30 is day 167 / day 61), adjust_once (no adjustment references them); declared overwrites: the one-claim whole-reversal sentence and the reason list. The payment (plan_premium_paid) has no gate on payments in plan_evt_premium (policy_scope); declared overwrites: the oldest-first allocation sentence and 'only by paying the past-due balance in full'. Termination consistency: continuous eligibility ran 2025-05-01..2026-04-30, so the 2026-04-30 non-payment termination at renewal is allowed; the oldest unpaid month 2025-10 was due 2025-09-20 with grace through 2025-11-19.

6. Business-object card. Membership <m1> only. Premiums: 17 bills of 50.00 (2025-01..2026-05), 9 payments (2025-01..2025-09), no waiver; owed months 2025-10..2026-04; void 2026-05. Course batch: outpatient hospital claims of NPI 1629384750 from 2025-10; excluded the 2025-09-29 evaluation. Ambulance batch: the three ambulance claims of NPI 1386027451. Other claims (inpatient stay, orthopedic, primary care, lab) are outside both batches.

7. Persona. Tired, plain-spoken father calling from his car; volunteers only the goal (pay what is needed to get her back on today) and true context (CP, wheelchair van, therapy, coverage ended in April over missed premiums, bills higher than expected). Gives Medicaid ID, DOB, phone, ZIP, SSN last four only when asked; a general go-ahead for corrections; pays by phone with his debit card only when handed the payment; asks whether re-enrollment is cleared, then ends.

8. Standard solution. find_customers(PR16628407) -> verify (PR16628407, 2014-02-19) -> memberships -> premiums -> claims -> authorizations -> ride benefit -> ride trips -> care enrollment -> care activities -> course re-rating 73.50 on C26-0105-40690 -> ambulance re-rating 28.50 on C26-0424-43512 -> hand over the payment: membership <m1>, 2026-04, 98.00, phone_ivr.

9. Verification. sim.py replays the gold writes with the real tools and evaluates every compute through check_compute's own evaluator at each handling time: 73.5 / 28.5 / 98.0; skip sensitivity 171.50 / 126.50; reverse order identical. Gates --task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK. check_traceability not run (KB not yet published).

10. Draft recomputation from the visible context: the published rules state the baseline and every ladder; the premium ledger, claim ledger, authorization, ride and care returns carry every figure; the coverage month is pinned by 'against the coverage month in which the membership ended' and each adjustment's claim by 'most recently serviced ... of the batch'. A reader reaches the same three writes in dependency order.

Revision log: (a) review date moved from 2026-06-23 to 2026-06-30 and termination to the 2026-04-30 renewal so month windows align with calendar months (the course scope factor was decorative with a day-23 review); (b) unread pharmacy rows dropped; (c) PCP, therapy-authorization month computations guarded so every policy evaluates to 0.00 in a world that lacks the record rather than failing.

Round 2 (audit audits/policy_task/member_cost_sharing_and_renewal): seed rows made charter-consistent — authorization PA-2510-121604 is expired (closed 2026-04-11, units released) after its 2026-04-10 end date, and the Care Coordination Level 2 episode closed 2026-04-30 with membership_ended as plan_terminate triggers; the therapy course reads an authorization approved on a request received in the therapy window whether still approved or since expired, the intake fall-through is a course carried over or retro-approved and never exceeds the course, and every care condition reads an episode enrolled in the window instead of an active one. F4 — the void-bill ladder is keyed on when the post-termination bill posted, and the credit-offset ladder on which credits were booked; no conjunct restates the policy's scope and every tier is reachable by a lockout payer. F1 — both re-ratings declare an overwrite of plan_evt_copay's schedule sentence. F2/F3 — half-up rounding and rolling window wording. Values unchanged: 73.50 / 28.50 / 98.00.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond Brevard-Oyelowo, father of twelve-year-old Anouk Brevard-Oyelowo, and you are calling Prairie Ridge Health Plan on a Tuesday late in the morning from your car in the parking lot at work. Anouk has cerebral palsy, uses a power wheelchair, rides to her appointments in a wheelchair van, and was going to physical therapy until this spring. Her Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids coverage ended at the end of April because the premiums fell behind over the winter; money was tight and the bills kept coming at a higher amount than you expected. A letter said she can only get back on during a waiting period if the past-due balance is paid. You have the money now and you want to pay whatever balance is needed to get her back on today. You want the exact amount worked out properly from her records; you are not trying to argue about it, and you have no figure in mind.

You are calm and a little tired, and you say so plainly. When the representative asks for details to find and verify Anouk, you give them one at a time as asked: her Medicaid ID is PR16628407, her date of birth is 2014-02-19 (February 19, 2014), the phone number on her file is 4025510738, your home ZIP code is 68505, and the last four of her Social Security number are 1947.

If the representative wants to straighten out anything on her account that needs it before working out the balance, you tell them to go ahead. When they hand the payment over to you, you pay it yourself by phone with your debit card for the amount and month they give you. You have no amount or confirmation number in mind ahead of time, and you repeat the confirmation number only if the payment gives you one and they ask for it.

If the representative asks why the premiums fell behind, you say money was short over the winter and you did not ask for any help at the time. If they ask whether anything else is wrong on her account, you say you would not know and you trust them to check. Once your payment is confirmed you ask whether that clears the way for her to be re-enrolled, thank them for the answer, and end the call.

edges.condition: The claim ledger holds an adjustment entry, booked against the most recently serviced visit of the approved therapy course, that returns the course copay excess.
edges.policy_source: The lockout balance is not accepted until the visits of the member's approved therapy course carry their course re-rating adjustment entry.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The course visits (latest C26-0105-40690) carry the 15.00 outpatient copay each and no adjustment entry references any of them.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The course re-rating entry of -73.50 is booked today, inside the counting window, so the reversals offset against the balance grow by 73.50.

edges.condition: The claim ledger holds an adjustment entry, booked against the most recently serviced ambulance claim under review, that returns the transport copay excess.
edges.policy_source: The lockout balance is fixed only after the ambulance claims under review carry their ambulance re-rating adjustment entry.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The three ambulance claims (latest C26-0424-43512) carry the 10.00 ambulance copay and no adjustment entry references them.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and commute: the course re-rating reads outpatient claims of the therapy provider, the authorization, ride and care records; the ambulance re-rating reads ambulance claims, ride, auth and care records; neither reads the other's adjustment entry (both filter booked claims). Replaying E before G gives the same values 73.50 / 28.50 / 98.00 and a byte-identical terminal DB (sim.py run).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the course re-rating the offset loses 73.50 and the payment becomes 171.50 instead of 98.00.
Without the ambulance re-rating the offset loses 28.50 and the payment becomes 126.50 instead of 98.00.
